title: Regulations for Direct-to-Consumer Genetic Testing Services
what_it_is: Regulations for Direct-to-Consumer Genetic Testing Services

sections.label: MOH regulation of genetic testing
sections.summary: MOH regulates clinical genetic testing but not direct-to-consumer tests for wellness, ancestry and nutrigenomics, and issued 2021 guidance on non-clinical testing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) takes a risk-based approach to the regulation of genetic testing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Aligned to this approach, we regulate clinical genetic testing but not direct-to-consumer (DTC) tests used for general wellness, ancestry and nutrigenomic purposes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, MOH has issued a guidance document in May 2021 which outlines good practices for providers offering non-clinical genetic testing and educates consumers on the risks of such testing.

sections.label: MOH monitoring DTC genetic testing
sections.summary: MOH will keep monitoring direct-to-consumer genetic testing and review its regulation and consumer education for public safety, privacy and welfare.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH will continue to monitor the development of DTC genetic testing and review our regulatory initiatives and consumer education efforts to ensure the safety, privacy and welfare of the public.

sections.label: Non-clinical genetic tests defined
sections.summary: Non-clinical genetic tests typically do not address medical conditions or disorders and are usually used for general wellness or recreation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: With regard to non-clinical genetic tests, these are typically those that do not address medical conditions or disorders and are usually used for general wellness or recreational purposes.

sections.label: Clinical genetic tests defined
sections.summary: Clinical genetic tests are used to assess, diagnose, prevent, alleviate and predict risks or treat a medical condition or disorder.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In contrast, the clinical genetic tests are used to assess, diagnose, prevent, alleviate and predict risks or treat a medical condition or disorder.

sections.label: Health Information Bill and future regulation
sections.summary: MOH is looking at the Health Information Bill as a way to enhance protection and will watch for any need for further regulatory enhancements.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Moving forward, we are also looking at the development of the Health Information Bill.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And these are also ways in which we can enhance protection further.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But we will watch and see whether there is any need for further regulatory enhancements in this space.
